text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 1 Positional evidence minus chance agreement

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Let W = Σi wi and M be the one-to-one matched pairs. Coverage C = Σ(i,j)∈M wi / W.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Position score P = Σ(i,j)∈M wi·Qij / W − Σi wi·ci / W.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: ci = min(1, Σj 1[||oi|−|pj|| < τ] · (2/π)·asin(min(τ/max(|oi|,0.1),1))).

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: RMS = √mean(dij²) over matched pairs, without intensity weighting. Chance correction accounts for prediction density.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 2 Scale preference

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Existing modes: S = λ mean[((sₖ − 1)/0.05)²]. Fixed mode: S = 0.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Overall + c/a: S = λ[ln(s)/ln(1.05)]² + μ[ln(r)/ln(1.05)]²; s = √(sa·sc), r = sa/sc.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: λ = μ = 0.10 initially. No ratio cost if c is invisible. Ranking preferences, not strain limits or parameter-count corrections.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 3 Check additional weak maxima and unsupported predictions

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Search unmatched prediction sites within r = max(0.10, window/spot width). Exclude strong-peak neighbourhoods; use

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: one-to-one weak assignments. In FFT mode this separate weak detector uses σ = 0.65 bins, a 1.8 floor and local

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: annular median/MAD contrast.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: For assessable sites, weak qualities include distance and bounded local contrast. B = max(0, weak quality per

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: predicted node − mean of 11 rotated-control values).

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: F = unsupported predictions / assessable predictions. Edge, masked or unreliable sites are unchecked rather than

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: penalized. Missing predictions are not proof of absent reflections.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(91%,95%,95%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 4 Adjusted rank

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: R = P − S + η·B − η·F. λ controls overall scale; μ controls c/a in ratio mode; η controls peak evidence. Default λ = 0.10

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: and η = 0.10.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(64%,70%,74%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 0.9; fill: rgb(91%,95%,95%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;fill: rgb(8%,35%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: 5 Acceptance screen

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Require ≥4 original strong matched profiles, directional spread max|sin(θi−θj)| > 0.5, C > 0.30, P > 0.20 and final R >

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;
font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: Weak maxima change rank but do not count toward four strong profiles. Passing is compatibility evidence, not a

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px;fill: rgb(9%,16%,22%); stroke:none;

g.text: confirmed phase.
